intro: Dominica is the 'Nature Island' of the Caribbean and home to the region's last Kalinago territory.

chapters.title: The Kalinago
text: The Kalinago resisted European settlement longer here than almost anywhere in the Caribbean. Today the Kalinago Territory is home to about 3,000 Kalinago people.

highlight.title: Kalinago Territory
highlight.text: The only Indigenous territory of its kind in the eastern Caribbean.

chapters.title: French and British rule
text: France and Britain fought over Dominica; Britain took control in 1763. Escaped enslaved people formed Maroon communities in the mountains.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Dominica became independent in 1978 as a republic. Hurricane Maria in 2017 damaged almost every building, and Dominica aims to become the world's first climate-resilient nation.

timeline.title: First woman PM
timeline.text: Eugenia Charles, first in the Caribbean.
